}}'''Owein''' was [[Warder]] to [[Alanna Mosvani]]. 

== Activities ==
It can be presumed that he was on the [[Amyrlin]]'s entourage to [[Fal Dara]] in Alanna's company.{{ref/book|2|2}}

He was killed by [[Whitecloaks]] near [[Watch Hill]] in the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref/book|4|31}}

== In the television series ==
In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], Owein's character is renamed {{TVlink|Maksim}} and is portrayed by {{TVlink|Taylor Napier}}.
